headline: Four new faces join cabinet as Mirza Fakhrul takes oath as President
summary: Moyeen Khan, Andaleeve Partho, Saching Pru Jerry, and Shamim Kaiser Lincoln are expected to join the cabinet in a reshuffle tonight.
details: The BNP-led government is set for its first cabinet reshuffle tonight, Friday, following the swearing-in of Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as President at Bangabhaban.
caption:
A major cabinet reshuffle is underway tonight! Four new members are joining the government.

The BNP-led government is set for its first cabinet reshuffle tonight, Friday, following the swearing-in of Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as President at Bangabhaban.

headline: 928 children dead as measles outbreak worsens in Bangladesh
summary: Three more children died within 24 hours, while 940 others were hospitalized with measles or measles-like symptoms, according to the DGHS.
details: Three children died within the last 24 hours due to measles-like symptoms, bringing the total death toll to 928, according to a DGHS update on Friday.
The deceased children were from Dhaka, Sylhet, and Khulna. In the same period, 940 children were admitted to hospitals with measles or measles-like symptoms.
Of the 940 newly admitted children, 64 have been confirmed to have measles, while 876 are showing symptoms.
Since March 15, the country has recorded 147,591 suspected measles cases, with 18,208 cases confirmed by medical tests.
caption:
928 children have died in a measles outbreak. 3 more died in just 24 hours.

Three children died within the last 24 hours due to measles-like symptoms, bringing the total death toll to 928, according to a DGHS update on Friday.

The deceased children were from Dhaka, Sylhet, and Khulna. In the same period, 940 children were admitted to hospitals with measles or measles-like symptoms.

Of the 940 newly admitted children, 64 have been confirmed to have measles, while 876 are showing symptoms.

Since March 15, the country has recorded 147,591 suspected measles cases, with 18,208 cases confirmed by medical tests.
